channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about LaMarcus Aldridge | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about LaMarcus Aldridge from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kyle Filipowski on Chris Paul, LaMarcus Aldridge, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Kyle Filipowski:

“There are players like Chris Paul, Luka, and LaMarcus Aldridge whom I admire for different aspects of their game. Chris Paul for his IQ, Luka Doncic for playing within himself and using his strengths, and LaMarcus Aldridge for his dominance and shooting ability.”

Kyle Filipowski on Chris Paul, LaMarcus Aldridge, Luka Doncic, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on LaMarcus Aldridge retiring:

“He was wonderful, he was a great teammate,he had a great sense of humor... He enjoyed what he did, and he certainly did it as long as he possibly could.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 31, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Steve Nash on Kevin Durant, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on why the #Nets are resting both Kevin Durant and LaMarcus Aldridge tonight vs. the #Rockets:

“I told them you guys (the media) were really on me for rest.”

Steve Nash on Kevin Durant, LaMarcus Aldridge, Dec 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Nash on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“When he scores, it makes us a better team because our second unit is functional and efficient.”

Steve Nash on LaMarcus Aldridge, Nov 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge's retirement:

“I was really worried for him. He had an episode three years ago and it was serious. Scared the hell out of us. But he's had a long, great career. He's going to be fine financially, but your health is what makes everything tick.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Apr 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Sean Marks on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Sean Marks on filling LaMarcus Aldridge's roster spot:

“I don't want to jump to any conclusions on what we might need.”

Sean Marks on LaMarcus Aldridge, Apr 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Damian Lillard on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Royce Young:Damian Lillard on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“He's one of the greatest players to play here. His jersey should be retired here.”

Damian Lillard on LaMarcus Aldridge, Apr 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Blake Griffin on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“In the beginning of the season, if you'd said that James and LaMarcus and I would end up with the Nets -- everybody's betting against that.”

Blake Griffin on LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 29, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on outside reaction to the #Nets adding Griffin and Aldridge:

“I don’t know what we’re supposed to do: Stand pat and not try to improve?... That’s the idea of this league, is to try to get better.”

Steve Nash on Blake Griffin, LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Aldridge:

“He’s been a great teammate, there’s no problem there. We just think this is a win-win for LaMarcus and the club. When an opportunity arises, that will be up to management, his agent and we will all move forward.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Jakob Poeltl on playing without LaMarcus Aldridge for the restart:

“I’m personally taking on the challenge. It’s a team effort, he was one of our main two guys.”

Jakob Poeltl on LaMarcus Aldridge, Jul 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Brian Wright on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:Spurs GM Brian Wright on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“We tried to take advantage of the hiatus period with rehab. Unfortunately it just didn't progress as we all had hoped.”

Brian Wright on LaMarcus Aldridge, Jun 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Jakob Poeltl:

“Tim and LaMarcus have helped me a lot. Working with Tim on a regular basis, him giving me tips and tricks for games. Going against L.A. in practice on a daily basis has really helped me improve my game. I’m trying to take advantage of that opportunity as best possible.”

Jakob Poeltl on LaMarcus Aldridge, May 21, 2020. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Robert Horry on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“They did that with LaMarcus *(Aldridge) in (2015) and hopefully other people follow suit. But it might be they don’t…I hate to say it, but San Antonio is not a destination where guys want to go play.”

Robert Horry on LaMarcus Aldridge, Feb 13, 2020. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Michael Malone on LaMarcus Aldridge, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Jabari Young:Malone on #Spurs #Nuggets heading into GM2:

“We know they are going to double-team Nikola. They know we're going to double-team LaMarcus Aldridge. Now it's a matter of spacing the floor the right way, stepping into your shot and shooting with it confidence”

Michael Malone on LaMarcus Aldridge, Nikola Jokic, Apr 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @JabariJYoung.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on LaMarcus Aldridge, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Donovan Mitchell on Rudy Gobert's matchup vs. LaMarcus Aldridge:

“Big fella took that one personally and I think we got another one in Golden State that I think we’ll take personally. I love to see that.”

Donovan Mitchell on LaMarcus Aldridge, Rudy Gobert, Feb 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Steve Kerr on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Pregame -Steve Kerr on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“I think he’s the toughest big men in the league to guard year after year. He’s got the old school, back- to-the-basket game.”

Steve Kerr on LaMarcus Aldridge, Feb 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @JeffGSpursZone.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on LA playing with a sore left wrist:

“He showed a lot of heart. LaMarcus took one for the team tonight sort of. I really wanted to sit him, but he was adamant about playing tonight, so we let him go.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Jan 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Jeff Garcia:Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“He’s been a beast all year long. He anchors us on both ends of the floor.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Jan 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @JeffGSpursZone.

item.title: Brad Stevens on DeMar DeRozan, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Brad Stevens on LaMarcus Aldridge and DeMar DeRozan:

“I think DeRozan has averaged 60 against the Celtics the last four years. It doesn’t matter where they are shooting from, they’re just studs.”

Brad Stevens on DeMar DeRozan, LaMarcus Aldridge, Dec 30, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
He also had two double-doubles during that torrid run, capping it with a regular-season career-high 45 points in an overtime win over the Utah Jazz last Friday.

“Considering the way he’s been playing and our recent success in those games, we are at the point where if LaMarcus gets a cough, a cold, we are in deep trouble,”

Manu Ginobili on LaMarcus Aldridge, Mar 28, 2018. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Patty Mills on LaMarcus Aldridge, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Patty Mills told Yahoo Sports.

“We’re getting good wins, and even when we do lose, they tend to be mistakes that we can fix. When [Leonard] comes back, we’re obviously going to have to adjust, but we’ll cross that bridge when we get to it. But so far this season, it’s been a team effort. Obviously, [Aldridge] has been carrying a huge part of the weight, but everybody else complements and understands what they need to do, so it’s a good way to feel for sure.”

Patty Mills on LaMarcus Aldridge, Kawhi Leonard, Dec 11, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: RC Buford on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“I think Pau [Gasol] and LaMarcus have obviously been significant and the contributions of other guys who have filled in and come together well. We're obviously not the best team in the league. But the group has taken care of its responsibilities in a way that puts them in a position to win.”

RC Buford on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge, Nov 29, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Aldridge:

“So far, he’s had a great season. He came in in great shape, really committed, much more comfortable, much more confident in the system, playing freely, and he’s been a great leader on top of it all. He’s been are most consistent player.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Nov 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: David Lee on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“Those two guys (Aldridge and Gasol) are established All-Stars. I want to come in here and whatever minutes I’m given,I’m going to play them with energy.”

David Lee on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge, Sep 29, 2016. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Tony Parker on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Tony Parker:

“I trust Kawhi and LaMarcus to have big games. When I was the main guy with Timmy, my teammates trusted me to come through.”

Tony Parker on LaMarcus Aldridge, May 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Zach Randolph on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Zach Randolph on LaMarcus Aldridge:

“LaMarcus was my rookie. I've seen him grow into a great person, a great player, a great teammate. I'm happy for him.”

Zach Randolph on LaMarcus Aldridge, Apr 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Pop on Aldridge:

“He's a guy who's getting used to this system more & more every game & feeling more & more comfortable.”

Gregg Popovich on LaMarcus Aldridge, Dec 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaPS.

item.title: Danny Green on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Danny Green, on LaMarcus Aldridge changing Spurs:

“We haven’t had one of those guys we can just throw it to and say, ‘Get us a bucket.’ We have that now”

Danny Green on LaMarcus Aldridge, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Paul Allen on LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
Paul Allen:

“No. I think LaMarcus had a lot of options. We went down to Dallas, Neil (Olshey) and I pitched him and he chose to go a different direction. We made it to his last few choices and he was good enough to call me up and explain his decision and all that. It's tough for a franchise, because we were all thinking that we had a real shot at getting him back. But in the end, he chose to go a different direction and now it's a new day. We've moved on and I think you can feel the excitement and the energy in the gym now.”

Paul Allen on LaMarcus Aldridge, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Oregonian.
